name: Stone of Controlling Earth Elementals

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Summon an Earth Elemental
powers.text: Magic action (once per dawn): An Earth Elemental appears in the space nearest the stone. It obeys you and takes its turn right after yours, and it's gone after 1 hour, at 0 Hit Points, or when you dismiss it.

powers.name: Dismiss the elemental
powers.text: Bonus Action: send back the Earth Elemental you called with the stone.

summary: Once a day, call an Earth Elemental that obeys you for up to 1 hour.
text: Take a Magic action with the stone to call an Earth Elemental into the unoccupied space nearest it. The elemental understands your languages, does as you command, and takes its turn immediately after yours. It's gone after 1 hour, when it drops to 0 Hit Points, or when you dismiss it as a Bonus Action. The stone can't call another until the next dawn.
